title: Hydra
wikitext:
[[image:hydra.jpg|thumb|A hydra]]
A '''hydra''' is a huge, three-headed beast.  They are found at the coasts of [[Darkshore]], [[Ashenvale]] and [[Azshara]]. They are amphibious and each head has its own will. They are intelligent and might be the favoured pets or servants of the [[Old Gods]].
